meta.name: Maharashtra Cropping Seasons
meta.disclaimer: Season month windows are conventional Maharashtra definitions used as engine inputs; exact sowing windows shift yearly with monsoon onset.

seasons.name: Kharif (Monsoon)
seasons.description: Sown with the southwest monsoon onset (June), harvested around October.
notes: Onset date varies yearly; engine should eventually use live rainfall signals.

seasons.name: Rabi (Post-Monsoon)
seasons.description: Sown October-November on residual moisture or irrigation, harvested February-March.
notes: In Nashik this season depends heavily on irrigation infrastructure.

seasons.name: Summer
seasons.description: Irrigated hot-season cropping between rabi harvest and monsoon onset.
notes: High heat stress risk; viable only with assured water.

seasons.name: Perennial / Orchard Cycle
seasons.description: Multi-year horticulture cycles (grapes, pomegranate, guava) managed through bahar treatments and pruning calendars.
notes: Annual economics modeled per production cycle, not calendar year.
